voice: Kokoro v1.0 af_heart (kokoro-onnx, open weights), speed 0.96

open1.text: This is a simulated benchmark, in its third round: two alloy discovery campaigns, replayed for a whole year in a digital twin of our planned automated lab.
open1.spoken: This is a simulated benchmark, in its third round: two alloy discovery campaigns, replayed for a whole year in a digital twin of our planned automated lab.
open1.phonemes: ðɪs ɪz ɐ sˈɪmjʊlˌeɪɾᵻd bˈɛntʃmɑːɹk, ɪn ɪts θˈɜːd ɹˈaʊnd: tˈuː ˈælɔɪ dɪskˈʌvɚɹi kæmpˈeɪnz, ɹˈiːpleɪd fɚɹə hˈoʊl jˈɪɹ ɪn ɐ dˈɪdʒɪɾəl twˈɪn ʌv ˌaʊɚ plˈænd ˈɔːɾəmˌeɪɾᵻd lˈæb.

open2.text: Some of it comes from real sources: the lab's design and its 3-D model, footage from our own atomizer, the search spaces in the two proposals, and published prices. Everything else is simulated: every alloy, every measurement, and every result.
open2.spoken: Some of it comes from real sources: the lab's design and its three D model, footage from our own atomizer, the search spaces in the two proposals, and published prices. Everything else is simulated: every alloy, every measurement, and every result.
open2.phonemes: sˌʌm ʌv ɪt kˈʌmz fɹʌm ɹˈiːəl sˈɔːɹsᵻz: ðə lˈæbz dɪzˈaɪn ænd ɪts θɹˈiː dˈiː mˈɑːdəl, fˈʊɾɪdʒ fɹʌm ˌaʊɚɹ ˈoʊn ˈæɾəmˌaɪzɚ, ðə sˈɜːtʃ spˈeɪsᵻz ɪnðə tˈuː pɹəpˈoʊzəlz, ænd pˈʌblɪʃt pɹˈaɪsᵻz. ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ˈɛls ɪz sˈɪmjʊlˌeɪɾᵻd: ˈɛvɹi ˈælɔɪ, ˈɛvɹi mˈɛʒɚmənt, ænd ˈɛvɹi ɹɪzˈʌlt.

chg1.text: Round three removes the cap on work in flight. What sets the pace now is physical: stations, robots, people and fixtures. Decisions come every simulated hour, one spending plan paces the money for every policy, and the thirty-day immersion gives interim readings and can be stopped early.

dag1.text: Each campaign is a function network: a chain of steps, where each step's results feed the next. BOFN, Bayesian optimization over function networks, models every step, not just the final score.
dag1.spoken: Each campaign is a function network: a chain of steps, where each step's results feed the next. B O F N, Bayesian optimization over function networks, models every step, not just the final score.
dag1.phonemes: ˈiːtʃ kæmpˈeɪn ɪz ɐ fˈʌŋkʃən nˈɛtwɜːk: ɐ tʃˈeɪn ʌv stˈɛps, wˌɛɹ ˈiːtʃ stˈɛps ɹɪzˈʌlts fˈiːd ðə nˈɛkst. bˈiː ˈoʊ ˈɛf ˈɛn, beɪˈiːʒən ˌɑːptɪmᵻzˈeɪʃən ˌoʊvɚ fˈʌŋkʃən nˈɛtwɜːks, mˈɑːdəlz ˈɛvɹi stˈɛp, nˌɑːt dʒˈʌst ðə fˈaɪnəl skˈɔːɹ.

dag2.text: For aluminium, the lab makes each alloy's powder itself, then prints it and checks every build.
dag2.spoken: For aluminum, the lab makes each alloy's powder itself, then prints it and checks every build.
dag2.phonemes: fɔːɹ ɐlˈuːmɪnəm, ðə lˈæb mˌeɪks ˈiːtʃ ˈælɔɪz pˈaʊdɚɹ ɪtsˈɛlf, ðˈɛn pɹˈɪnts ɪt ænd tʃˈɛks ˈɛvɹi bˈɪld.

dag3.text: For copper, a one-hour corrosion screen ranks the DED deposits, and thirty days in seawater come before a utility is known.
dag3.spoken: For copper, a one-hour corrosion screen ranks the D E D deposits, and thirty days in seawater come before a utility is known.

dag4.text: Both campaigns share one lab. From here on, each step is an icon that lights up while it runs.

fig1.text: Best so far is the highest utility of any new alloy tested yet. The first dotted line is the best existing alloy on this synthetic benchmark. One random design in twelve beats it, so it is a low bar.

fig2.text: The second line is the halfway target: halfway from there to the best alloy the twin's own search found.
fig2.spoken: The second line is the halfway target: halfway from there to the best alloy the twin's own search found.

fig3.text: The grey dashed curve is a conventional lab run by rule of thumb, through partner and core facilities. It orders its metal as it goes, while the automated lab starts stocked.
fig3.spoken: The grey dashed curve is a conventional lab run by rule of thumb, through partner and core facilities. It orders its metal as it goes, while the automated lab starts stocked.

fig4.text: Days to a target are the median over twelve runs. Here the automated lab reaches the halfway target on day 83, in 10 of its 12 runs. The conventional lab does on day 337, in only 6 of 12, so its median is its last run to get there. The factor is therefore a lower bound: at least 4.0 times.

asm1.text: One assumption matters more than the rest. In the twin, the atomizer has sixteen start slots a week and uses about ten, and a run fails six percent of the time, more for a cold melt. The lab's own record so far is 1.7 runs a week, with problems in eight of ten runs. These are design targets, not demonstrated rates.

res2.text: Days to each target, with every run a mark. Time-aware BOFN and pKGFN reach aluminium's halfway target on day 96 and day 83, in 11 and 10 of 12 runs.
